raw_record.displayName: Automatically logs into email accounts (Gmail, Outlook, QQ Mail, etc.) and generates daily email summaries. Use when the user wants to get a summary of their emails, check important messages, or create daily email digests.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release.
- Provides automatic login to multiple email providers (Gmail, Outlook, QQ Mail, 163, etc.) and generates daily email summaries.
- Includes browser automation examples for both logged-in and manual login modes.
- Offers sample Bash and Python scripts for summary extraction and reporting.
- Features guidance for scheduled execution via crontab or launchd.
- Lists security best practices and troubleshooting tips.
